scientific_integrity: The polynomial distortion and surrogate-optimization viewpoint are credited to earlier work; the assessed claim is their sharp parity, curvature-ratio, unique-tuning and large-E classification. Infinite-range conclusions have analytic proofs. Calculations are exact or high-precision finite checks, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic scalar strongly convex quadratics; equal full averaging after E positive local steps; a shared step 0<alpha<2/max curvature; uniformity over arbitrary centers; only communication-round convergence. No general-network, vector-Hessian, noise or finite-precision guarantee.
title: Exact odd-epoch bias cancellation in heterogeneous local gradient descent
